verdict.rationale: Phoenix documents token-usage breakdowns per LLM call and lets you organize traces into projects and group them into sessions/conversations, which provides some basis for usage attribution by session/application. However, there is no evidence of a general custom-metadata/tagging mechanism for arbitrary attribution to users or features, nor any cost aggregation/dashboard that rolls up spend by user, session, or feature tag. missing for 10: explicit custom metadata/tagging API for attributing spans to users or features, cost-specific aggregation/dashboard views by user/session/feature, documentation showing cost roll-ups beyond raw token counts.
